d: Nvidia’s rise is changing the world, and the effects are reaching your pocket. From making smartphones and laptops more expensive to influencing global stock markets and even finding its way into Russian weapons used in Ukraine, the company’s chips have become central to the global economy. In this video, Firstpost examines how the AI boom fuelled unprecedented demand for computing power, tightened memory supplies and pushed up consumer prices. It also explores Nvidia’s growing presence in cars, robotics and industrial automation, the impact of the AI investment frenzy on Indian markets…
